patch_description: This crossover retains the stronger one-distinct-parameter economy of the current program while preserving the inspiration model’s separation of local basis changes and long-range correlations. The fixed nearest-neighbour CZ ring provides stable, symmetry-respecting local mixing. The four Möbius chords are changed from fixed CZ gates to shared-angle IsingXX rotations, allowing the same collective parameter to adapt long-range correlations without increasing the trainable parameter count. The final collective RZ layer remains tied to that parameter, producing a regularized but more expressive one-dimensional circuit trajectory.
